cues.en: Now, before getting into the details of what to do exactly in this exercise, I want to take a moment, a brief tangent, to explain what's called Brownian noise.

cues.en: Brownian noise, also called brown noise, is the cumulative sum of random numbers.
cues.zh: 布朗雜訊，也叫棕色雜訊，是隨機數的累積和。

cues.en: So basically you just generate a bunch of random numbers that can be positive or negative.
cues.zh: 基本上，先產生一堆可正可負的隨機數，

cues.en: You take their cumulative sum and that is brown noise.
cues.zh: 取它們的累積和，就得到棕色雜訊。

cues.en: Now because token IDs are only integers, we will just be summing the integers minus one and plus one.
cues.zh: 因為 token ID 只能是整數，所以只對負 1 與正 1 這兩個整數求和。

cues.en: So imagine this is a random sequence of plus ones and minus ones.
cues.zh: 假設這是正 1 與負 1 的隨機序列。

cues.en: And then the resulting Brownian noise will look like this.
cues.zh: 得到的布朗雜訊會像這樣。

cues.en: So basically each number here in this column is the cumulative sum of all of the previous plus ones
cues.zh: 基本上，這一欄每個數字，都是之前所有正 1

cues.en: and minus ones, which is the same thing as saying that you update the noise at each value according to the previous value, plus whatever is the corresponding random number.
cues.zh: 與負 1 的累積和；換句話說，每次用前一個值，加上當前對應的隨機數，更新雜訊值。

cues.en: Okay, so this is for a very small sequence.
cues.zh: 這裡只是一個很短的序列。

cues.en: You can generate longer sequences and it might look something like this.
cues.zh: 產生更長的序列，可能就會像這樣。

cues.en: In fact, if you add a positive linear trend to Brownian noise, it basically looks exactly like the stock market.
cues.zh: 事實上，若在布朗雜訊上加一個正向線性趨勢，看起來基本上就和股市一樣。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。
